params.name: participant_code
params.description:
Filters for positions based on the specific participant.

Note: multiple participant codes can be provided in the query string, separated by ampersands.
E.g. `participant_code=PLAT01&participant_code=PLAT02`

params.name: account_label
params.description: Filter by account label (e.g., `general`, `sub_account_test`). Account labels are used to categorize accounts under a participant. Each participant `account_label` maintains a separate balance and transaction history.

items.docs: Retrieve all platform positions maintained at zerohash.
